title: In-Place Foundational Deepening over Redundant Plugin Sprawl

claims.assertion: When foreign repository analysis discovers advanced capabilities in an existing functional domain (e.g. recursive AST shell security parsing), deepen the existing core plugin in-place rather than spawning parallel, shallow tool wrappers

context: Creating parallel plugins that perform similar duties (e.g. two separate shell tokenizers) creates maintenance fragmentation and confuses agent tool selection.
